items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: So Diz, Lamar Wright and Chad Collins was sitting right next to me.

ctx.x: Sitting in the audience and so we closed with "Paradiddle". So Diz, Lamar Wright and Chad Collins was sitting right next to me. I was elevated and they're on that tier right next to me, and so "Paradiddle" came up there and that was upstairs, really fast. So I started it off and boy it was going great, fast, I had it a little faster than I really wanted to, but I made it. So it was on the cymbal for a while, tom-toms, snare drum things, so by then I was going so fast it sort of got me all messed up because I'm…

But luckily all I did was knock the sound post out and so he got somebody and they fixed the sound post and it was good, he could use his bass. But he'll tell you about that story right today. "Cozy, you remember that time you stepped in my bass?" I said "I never will forget it."
